# The tests that .github/scripts/vpntest.ps1 does not run as a smoke test: <name> <reason>, one per line.
#
# Every other test that "vpntest list" prints runs, in every job that calls the script: a new test is a new file with a
# RANZ_TEST line (src/vpntest/testlist.h) and needs no line here. A line names a test that vpntest lists, or the script
# fails. asan-exclude.txt holds what the fuzz-asan job leaves out besides these.
s              the start/stop smoke test, which the script runs first with a check of its own
memory_leak    leaks one byte on purpose
bgp            needs ranz and gobgpd next to vpntest and administrator rights: .github/scripts/bgp-spike.ps1 runs it
selfintegrity  needs a signed binary: .github/scripts/self-integrity.ps1 runs it
sdntrace       needs the address and key of a running controller: .github/scripts/sdn-tracer.ps1 runs it
firsttest      needs the address and key of a running controller, administrator rights and wintun.dll next to vpntest: .github/scripts/first-test.ps1 runs it
kmtest         needs administrator rights, a KM-TEST adapter and the drivers of ranz install: the kmtest job runs it (.github/scripts/kmtest.ps1)
